description: Automated Weather Observation System is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. This layer was created from the California Aviation System Plan list of Automated Weather Observation Systems. The upgrades and distribution of Automated Weather Observing Systems (AWOS) Automated Surface Observation Systems (ASOS), and Automated Terminal Information Services (ATIS) in California are a critical part of the State aviation system. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Airport, ASOS, ATIS, AWOS, California, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA. The bounding box given is -0.0011,0.0003,-0.0010,0.0004. The hub shows 2024-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (This public data is provided as a service for planning purposes and not intended for design, navigation purposes or airs ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
